findings.requestedRepair: Anchor the build format to the full string and explicitly define allowed suffixes; reject malformed patch/build context.

findings.detail: Nested NaN, Infinity, functions, undefined, BigInt and omitted undefined profession values pass context validation. JSON serialization can erase, coerce or fail on these distinct states.
findings.requestedRepair: Validate every nested specialization/gear/unlocks leaf as a typed finite JSON-safe value; preserve explicit unknown, reject unsupported types; snapshot/canonicalize provenance before using it as identity.

findings.detail: scenarioBounds accepts missing outputQualityRank and deliberately swapped rank values. Correct IDs alone do not establish output rank identity.
findings.requestedRepair: Require each output rank and exact equality to context.outputQualityRanks[id], rejecting missing/mismatched ranks before any scenario arithmetic.

findings.detail: Finite inputs can overflow to Infinity/NaN in historicalRateAlternatives, scenarioBounds and analyzeCasts economics, producing non-finite estimates and invalid decision labels.
findings.requestedRepair: Guard every computed hypothesis, revenue, cost, margin, covariance and variance for finite numeric results before returning; fail closed on overflow.
